legal.title: Legal notice
legal.description: Publisher, host and contact details for O-Fests.
legal.publisherBody: This site is published on a non-professional basis by a private individual, who has chosen to remain anonymous under article 1-1, II of French law no. 2004-575 of 21 June 2004 on trust in the digital economy (LCEN). Their identity and contact details have been given to the host.
legal.hostAddress: 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States
legal.storageBody: Only your theme choice and, where applicable, your objection to audience measurement are stored in your browser. This storage does not require consent (CNIL: user interface customisation trackers, and trackers that keep the choices users have made about trackers). O-Fests has no accounts and no forms. The host processes technical connection data, including IP addresses, needed to serve and secure the site.
legal.audienceBody: O-Fests uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to produce anonymous traffic statistics: page views, where visits come from, device type, country. This tool sets no cookies and does not use your browser's storage. The data is used only to measure the site's audience. You can object to this measurement at any time with the button below; your choice is stored in your browser and applies from the next page.
audience.on: Audience measurement: on in this browser.
audience.off: Audience measurement: off in this browser.
audience.storageBlocked: Your browser blocks local storage: your choice will not be kept.

privacy.hosting.title: Technical data held by the host
privacy.hosting.purpose: Serving the site and keeping it secure.
privacy.hosting.basis: Legitimate interest (GDPR, art. 6(1)(f)): running and protecting the site.
privacy.hosting.data: IP address, browser, requested page, date and time of the request.
privacy.hosting.retention: Set by Cloudflare, which does not publish a specific period for this data; O-Fests does not control it.
privacy.hosting.transfers: Cloudflare is based in the United States. Transfers are covered by the Data Privacy Framework, or failing that by standard contractual clauses.
privacy.audience.title: Audience measurement
privacy.audience.purpose: Knowing how the site is used (pages viewed, where visits come from, device type, country) to decide how it evolves.
privacy.audience.basis: Legitimate interest (GDPR, art. 6(1)(f)). The measurement sets no cookies and does not use your browser's storage; it serves audience measurement only, within the CNIL's conditions for exemption from consent.
privacy.audience.data: IP address, browser, page viewed and referring page, received by Cloudflare to produce anonymous statistics.
privacy.audience.retention: Raw data is kept for 7 days by Cloudflare, then aggregated. Cloudflare does not publish a retention period for the aggregated data.
privacy.audience.recipients: Cloudflare, Inc., processor for the publisher (Cloudflare Web Analytics).
privacy.audience.transfers: Same safeguards as for the host: Data Privacy Framework, or failing that standard contractual clauses.

privacy.organizers.title: Exchanges with festival organisers
privacy.organizers.purpose: Contacting organisers to check and complete the information about their festival.
privacy.organizers.basis: Legitimate interest (GDPR, art. 6(1)(f)): keeping up to date a directory of public information about festivals.
privacy.organizers.data: Email address and content of the messages exchanged. Source: contact details published by the festival (official website, social media).
privacy.organizers.retention: 3 years after the organiser's last message, or 3 years after the first email that went unanswered.
privacy.organizers.recipients: The publisher, and Proton AG, provider of the contact@ofests.com mailbox, as processor.
privacy.organizers.transfers: The mailbox is hosted by Proton AG in Switzerland, a country recognised by the European Commission as providing an adequate level of protection.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask for access to your data, its rectification, its erasure, restriction of its processing, and object to its processing, by writing to the contact address above.
